search.coverage: First result sets and linked primary sources; no pagination or date filters. This is a bounded investigation, not global exhaustion.
search.dedup_result: The six root IDs were absent before creation in the named repository scientific trees. Related element records and primary DOIs were found and reused explicitly. Named raw paths were also searched, and relevant binary PDFs were extracted and reread. This is not a machine-wide absence claim.

selection: Six distinct IMA mineral identities: five records with bounded microbial substrate or product evidence, and one record with a phase-verified abiotic comparator. The unsupported microbial claim for pyrolusite is retained only as context. Reused experiments are not independent replications.

sources.role: primary experiment reused from tungsten record
sources.inspected: Fresh full-text XML and publisher PDF methods, results and discussion; Table 1 and rendered Figure 3 (PDF page 6), feed chemistry page 5 and EDS page 4.
sources.decision: Scheelite-bearing mixed concentrate microbial W mobilization; no pure mineral yield, energy-source identification, W-redox proof or WC recovery.
limits: Methods report 19 wt% Fe oxide while Table 1 gives 22.6 wt% Fe; these are unreconciled.
Figure 3 uses days while its caption says hours, and its log10/mg/L axis is ambiguous; no digitization.
Microscopy involved 30 days of oxic dehydration after the 21-day culture; carbide-like deposits are not confirmed pure WC.
This is the same experiment as the tungsten record, not new replication.

sources.role: primary experiment reused from lead record
sources.inspected: Fresh XML Experimental methods, Results, Discussion and Tables 1-3; retained publisher PDF and Figures 3-5 pixels after the fresh university PDF transfer was incomplete.
sources.decision: Controlled bacterial Pb remobilization from characterized synthetic pyromorphite; pH and pathways unresolved.
limits: Synthetic wet-chemistry formula Pb5.09(PO4)2.96Cl is retained; the feed is not a field soil.
The unusual reported 30 mM FeEDTA concentration is retained.
pH was not matched; 305-hour filtered Pb is separate from the 100-hour cell-associated 94% fraction.
No isolated product or durable field-remediation claim is made.

sources.inspected: Fresh XML Results 2.3 and 2.6 and Discussion: phosphate-condition phase assignments reverse across sections; only qualified context is reused.
sources.decision: Different deposition conditions do not directly refute dissolution, and disputed phosphate causality is not transferred.

sources.inspected: Fresh XML Methods and Results, and the university-hosted published PDF; rendered Table 1 and Figures 1-2 (PDF pages 5-6, printed pages 824-825).
sources.decision: Fungal phosphate mobilization from processed struvite/dittmarite mixture, not pure struvite conversion.
limits: Na2HPO4 in the medium and mixed feed phases prevent a species-specific mass balance.
The feed was pretreated at 105 degrees C for 48 hours; XRD showed struvite plus dittmarite.
pH 5.5 was before autoclaving, not a post-feed measurement.
No acid-matched abiotic contrast; Figure 2 compares inoculated cultures with versus without feed.
The Pi procedure is absent from the inspected methods; no complete dissolution fraction is inferred.

sources.role: one primary substrate-to-product assay reused from iron
sources.inspected: Fresh XML and publisher PDF methods, ferrihydrite results and Figures 1-4; retained supplement S2-S5, including rendered S2 and S5, after the fresh archive timed out.
sources.decision: Ferrihydrite reduction and magnetite-rich mixed formation are paired species perspectives on one assay, not independent experiments.
limits: The synthetic two-line substrate formula is not independently resolved to the ideal IMA formula.
All arms included 1.3 mM FeCl2 and 0.5 mM cysteine.
24 mM Fe(II) is from oxalate extraction, not dissolved iron or a yield.
84% pre-oxalate filter retention is not a magnetite phase percentage.
Mossbauer excludes pure magnetite; XRD cannot separate magnetite and maghemite. Minor magnetite is possible in the heated control.

sources.inspected: Fresh XML Experimental and Results/Discussion; publisher PDF Figure 1 on page 3 and Figures 2-3 on page 5 rendered. The supplementary acid-extraction table was not acquired, and no cells from it were imported.
sources.decision: Accept the microbial:false redox mechanism for characterized reagent beta-MnO2 as an abiotic alternative, not microbial causation.
limits: Co versus Cu radiation labels conflict.
Methods describe approximately 3 mM Fe(II) and 90-minute runs; Figure 2 uses measured 2.4 mM Fe(II) and 75-minute exposures.
Reaction temperature and replicate count remain unresolved.
The Mn assay does not speciate dissolved manganese; Mn(II) is inferred.
Later magnetite and maghemite are grouped; the Mn balance is nonstoichiometric.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0; CC0 for data unless otherwise indicated

sources.role: new microbial ore lead assessed, contextonly in record
sources.inspected: All eight pages of the publisher PDF; Methods on pages 713-714, Figures 2-4 and Table 1 on page 717. Figure 2 and Table 1 were visually checked.
sources.decision: Do not accept a phase-specific microbial mechanism: the feed is an uncharacterized mixed ore, the uninoculated ore control is missing, and protocol/composition reports conflict.
limits: The feed is reported as 25% Mn, 30.4% Fe and 34% S, with no XRD phase confirmation.
The C arm has 0 g/cm3 added mineral and is not a sterile ore control.
The methods repeat loading 0.03 while the caption lists 0.01; methods pH 6.0 conflicts with caption pH 2.0.
Table 1 uses atomic wording versus a mass-percent header. Day-16 values sum to 193.03%, not 100%.
Text claiming sulfur oxidation to H2S conflicts with the sulfate interpretation; sulfur causality is not accepted.
No strain accession is supplied, and no taxon ID was invented.
sources.license: Publisher full text openly readable; reuse license not independently resolved; no raw redistribution

correction_scope: Exact DOI correction and retraction queries found no identified notice in the first result sets. Six fresh Crossref records have empty relation fields and no update-to metadata. This bounded check cannot prove absence. Identified internal contradictions are retained.

deferred_leads.reason: The primary publisher abstract reports pyrolusite unaffected in the tested Enterobacter mixed-ore system. Full text and phase-normalization evidence were not acquired in this search; no methods or measurements were imported. Do not generalize to all conditions.
